featured_reviews.review_text:
Babu Vada pav is essentially a takeaway snack joint on the street; they have been operating in that location for decades. They transformed from a street food vendor on a wheeled cart to a takeaway snack joint.

There is no seating available so basically you can order a TAKEAWAY or have it on a disposable plate.

It's one of the "go-to" places for snacks in a 10 kilometre radius; Quality & is taste is a function of who's making the vada pav batter or batata bhaji ; salt / green chilli/ garlic proportions vary from time to time.

Likewise perception of service can also vary depending on who's on the service side of the counter or the type of crowd at peak hours

In addition to their Vada Pav,  Patti Samosa and Kothimbir Vadi are also to be savoured once. Sabudana vada is also good going by reviews of many esteemed  local guides

The type of snacks served uses copious amounts of garlic without which vada cannot get its taste; so if you are finicky about not having garlic for whatever reasons you may have to think twice before consuming

One of their dry chutneys also contains dry coconut and peanut in addition to garlic ; if you have allergies be aware of them before consuming

Parking is available on alternate sides of the streets on odd days and even days , but the proximity to street corners and bus stops make it a challenging task ; during off peak hours parking is available but the snacks may not be piping hot at that time.

There is also a school nearby so it can be chaotic during school rush hours or in the evening between 1730 - 1930 due to peak station going traffic

They do not sell any beverages but there is a sugarcane juice stall, tea stall nearby and several stores where one can buy bottled water or cold beverages.

Summarily definitely a decent place to have a small snack and if you are a regular you'd know when to visit them

Sandwizzaa is a popular all over & I visited their Vile Parle East outlet for a quick bite before heading for work . They offer jain/ vegetarian variety only.

When you compare Sandwizzaa to regular  sandwich outlets they may seem expensive (without the discounts offered )
but I find it worth the money when you consider the hygiene standards they maintain compared to regular stalls.
They offer a limited menu & hardly any drink variety but it’s acceptable as it’s a sandwich joint that offers you quick food on the go.

I love their Mayo Toast & Spinach Corn Toast more than their Sada sandwiches & cheese grilled sandwiches.

We were 4 & we ordered one sandwich each which is enough to fill your tummy for some time. If you plan to eat here for a full meal you might want to order cheese grilled sandwich or a couple of regular ones. One regular sandwich won’t be enough.

The Mayo Toast, Spinach Corn Toast in Brown bread is filling & tasted amazing
They do cut them in two pieces and serve you with green chutney, sauce & garlic chutney which is yummy.

Chilli Cheese Toast & Cheese Grilled sandwich is decent but honestly I’ve had better and at a cheaper rate.

Maha Veggie Sada sandwich is a good option if you wish to have a lighter sandwich with just veggies & don’t prefer toast.

Sandwizzaa offers Jain variety which is a good thing for all jain foodies out there.

I prefer Sandwizzaa mainly for their Mayo Toast and Spinach Corn in Brown bread. Other items are decent but these two are a must when you visit Sandwizzaa.

The seating area is slightly limited, so at peak times you might have to wait a bit or adjust accordingly. Parking can sometimes be a bit of a hustle, particularly during evenings and weekends, but if you’re walking in from the neighborhood, it’s not an issue at all.

When I asked them to cancel the item since we had already waited long enough, they suddenly claimed that it was “almost ready.” It appeared to be an attempt to buy more time rather than an honest update, as the item clearly had not been prepared.

The most unacceptable part of the visit was the staff’s attitude. When my father-in-law raised concerns about the service and behaviour, some staff members were laughing instead of apologizing or showing any concern. Such behaviour towards customers, especially senior citizens, is highly disrespectful and unprofessional.

I also noticed staff being rude to guests who were arriving and looking for seats. Instead of politely explaining the waiting situation, they were bluntly told to sit outside because there was no space available.

Good food can attract customers once, but courteous service and respect are what bring them back. Unfortunately, Anand Stall failed on both counts during our visit. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and works on improving both food taste and staff behaviour.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Lucky Sandwich ( Very popular ) is my fav sandwich joint in vile Parle.
It’s hardly a 5 min walk  from the Station
Trust me there are a few in & around vile Parle to choose from but my fav is Luck.
No Matter the time you visit they always have 10-12 Sada or masala toast ready for servicing customers quickly or for online orders .
It just shows how popular still this joint is
I’ve had everything they have to offer over the years but I still prefer the sandwiches over pizza’s here .
My Fav items are :-
1. Sada Sandwich
2. Veg Toast Sandwich
3. Cheese Chilli Grilled (Spicy & yummy)
4. Veg Cheese Grilled Sandwich

Overall Reviews
1. Location - Roadside Stall
2. Seating Capacity - No Seating Area
3. Menu Options - Plenty
4. Food Served - Sandwiches & Pizza
5. Service - Quick
6. Staff - Friendly
7. VFM - 4/5 ( Sandwich stall , friendly on your pocket

Note :- For a Light Snack you can opt for Sada, veg Toast or Masala Toast Sandwhich.
For a proper meal I would recommend Cheese Grilled Sandwich, Cheese Chilli Grilled or Pizza ‘s

Sada Sandwich - You can select white or brown bread , with butter , chutney , chat masala & veggies ( potato, cucumber, onion , tomato & Beat )
Gr8 No Toast / grill option & also perfect when you just want to have a light snack .

Veg Toast Sandwich - Same as Sada but is toasted & it’s my fav here .

Masala Toast - Difference between Veg Toast & Masala Toast is that it has aloo mix inside rather than cut veggies & if you like that do opt for cheese masala toast ( cheese makes it tastier )

Veg Cheese Grilled Sandwich - To fill your tummy this will do & it’s always a fav no matter where you have it from .
Veggies cut , cheese loaded & grilled with sauce & chutney in the side . 6 decent size pieces per order

Cheese Chilli Grilled
If you love cheese, chilli & don’t want veggies then this dish is for your . It’s yummy & spicy .

Pizza’s - I’ve tasted pizza’s here but I prefer the sandwiches more like most who come to Lucky .
Pizza’s here taste more like regular pizza’s from Aditi , Amar Juice ( I prefer their pizza’s though ).

Since online delivery services like swiggy have started it has benefited lucky & it’s customer as they can get home delivery of their fav sandwiches.

Lucky recently made minor renovations & installed CCTV camera ‘s .
Slight modification made are Personalised lucky sandwich papers & swiggy tape for takeaway orders.
Prices have increased post renovation but still is reasonably priced .

I have to admit even though it’s a road side stall , Atleast I haven’t fallen ill due to bad food products from Lucky no matter the weather or hygiene standards.

I wish Lucky could improve hygiene in & around their stall & have some sort of seating ( if possible ).
It’s difficult to stand & eat  your meal when it’s crowded, extreme heat or during rains . It’s annoying.

If your in Vile Parle West & don’t mind street food do try out Lucky Sandwich . You won’t be disappointed.

featured_reviews.name: Amal V
featured_reviews.review_text:
The King of Tarri in Vile Parle East: Paresh Misal.

If you are hunting for the most authentic and satisfying Misal Pav experience in Mumbai, Paresh Misal in Vile Parle East should be your ultimate destination. This establishment isn't just serving a dish; they're serving a culinary tradition, and they've perfected it over the years.
The star of the show is, without a doubt, the Misal itself. What sets Paresh Misal apart is the legendary 'tarri'—the spicy, fiery red gravy that packs an incredible punch. It's perfectly balanced, delivering a deep, authentic Maharashtrian flavor that will make your taste buds sing. If you like your food spicy and flavorful, this tarri is non-negotiable and guaranteed to hit the spot.
The Misal comes systematically served with generous portions of usal (sprouts curry), a crispy mix of farsan, chopped onions, lemon slices, and a basket of perfectly soft, hot buttered pav. The accompanying sides, which often include curd and sometimes a bit of poha or aloo sabzi, make the meal feel truly wholesome and excellent value for money.
Whether you're grabbing a quick bite or ordering one of their popular "family meal deals," the quality is consistently high, and the flavors are fresh. Paresh Misal proves that you don't need a fancy setting to serve world-class street food. It's a must-try quick bite for any food lover passing through Vile Parle.

Sharma Bhelpuri House in Vile Parle East Market is truly an iconic food destination and a landmark for chat lovers in the locality. It is popularly believed to be Sachin Tendulkar’s favourite chat place, and the walls proudly display photographs of occasions where Sharma Bhelpuri had set up counters at Sachin’s residence for Arjun Tendulkar’s birthday celebrations. This association alone tells you how special and loved this place is by generations of Parle residents.

Evenings here are vibrant, with crowds lining up to enjoy their famous chat items. Their Panipuri is absolutely outstanding—crisp puris, perfectly balanced spicy-sweet water, and fresh filling. It’s no surprise that the Panipuri counter is almost always surrounded by eager customers. Other must-try items include their Dahi Puri, Sevpuri, Bhelpuri, and the very popular Radha Patties, each prepared with consistent quality and delicious taste.

They do offer indoor seating, though it is somewhat limited due to their popularity. Despite the rush, service is quick, efficient, and well-managed. The hygiene and freshness they maintain while serving such fast-paced orders is genuinely commendable.

My personal favourite here is the Sevpuri—bursting with flavour and incredibly satisfying. If you are anywhere near Vile Parle East Market, this place is a must-visit for some delightful, authentic chat that never disappoints. Highly recommended!
